decision_question: Does reusing the exact observed whole-transaction gas-unit count at a current Polygon standard fee estimate consume the 5-share or 20-share maker-input margin under an executable POLUSDT best ask sensitivity?
interpretation_limits: The observed gas units belong to the whole outer transaction and do not isolate convertPositions.
A current fee recommendation is not the historical fee and does not prove a future inclusion price or latency.
POLUSDT is an executable top-of-book valuation sensitivity; USDT is not assumed equal to pUSD.
The screen cannot prove relayer eligibility, who pays gas, approvals, conversion access, or account execution.
No positive sensitivity result may promote an edge. A negative result may reject direct-gas economics only for these exact inputs.
stop_rules: Stop after exactly one attempt per listed request.
Stop without replacement or provider hopping on any transport, HTTP, schema, symbol, or numeric error.
Do not request account data, credentials, quotes, orders, conversions, or state changes.
